source_text: Si aspersum fuerit sanguis super vestimentum, lavabis in loco sancto. Macula oratione et lacrimis lavatur.
pass_a_gloss: If sprinkled will-have-been blood upon garment, you-will-wash in place holy. Stain with-prayer and tears is-washed.
pass_b_english: If blood is [[sprinkled on a garment, wash it in a holy place >> Bible:Leviticus 6:27]]. The stain is washed with prayer and tears.
